0022600029.text: The Grizzlies (6-2) host the Thunder (6-2) in their ninth game of the season, and Memphis is 6-2 over its last ten, though it enters on a two-game losing streak. The Grizzlies are 4-0 on the road but 2-2 at home, and they sit 3rd in the Southwest, half a game back. Oklahoma City, 2nd in the Northwest and also half a game back, is 4-0 at home and on a two-game winning streak, and it will be without Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg, fracture), Jaylin Williams (back, spasms), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee), while Memphis is missing Isaiah Stewart (knee, bruise) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back, soreness). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Oklahoma City won all three of its 2025-26 meetings with Memphis, including a 117-116 final in Memphis on January 9, 2026.
